test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the advancing of monsoon in India, which of the following cities receives rainfall after 15 June every year?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jaipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaipur** receives rainfall after 15 June every year due to the advancing **southwest monsoon.**
 
• The **southwest monsoon** generally reaches the **Rajasthan region** around the second half of June.
 
• Jaipur, being in the **northwestern part of India**, typically experiences a slight delay in the onset of monsoon rains compared to the coastal and southern regions.
 
• Other cities listed receive monsoon rains earlier than Jaipur due to their geographical locations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Imphal**__

 __
 
• **Imphal** is the capital city of the state of **Manipur** in northeastern India.
 
• It receives the **southwest monsoon** much earlier, typically around the beginning of June.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru**__
 __
 
• **Bengaluru** is located in the southern part of India in the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• It experiences monsoon rains in early June due to its proximity to the **Western Ghats**.
 
 
 
• **Hyderabad**__
 
 
• **Hyderabad** is the capital city of the state of **Telangana** in southern India.
 
• It typically receives monsoon rains in the first half of June.
